name: Level_2 - Task_10
description: Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator from the local path ./models/2023-12-03-mace-128-L1_epoch-199.model. Construct a bulk conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Aluminum (Al) with a lattice parameter a = 4.05 Å, and expand it into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell. Initialize atomic velocities for a target temperature of 300 K following a Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution. Set up a Langevin thermostat (NVT) simulation with a friction coefficient of 0.01 fs⁻¹ and a 1.0 fs timestep. Implement a control loop that increases the target temperature from 300 K to 900 K in increments of 100 K (evaluating 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, and 900 K). For each temperature plateau, run a total of 500 MD steps: use the first 400 steps for thermal equilibration, then use the final 100 steps for production sampling, recording the potential energy at every step. Calculate the average potential energy over these final 100 steps for each temperature plateau. Return a Python dictionary mapping each temperature integer (in K) to its corresponding average potential energy (in eV).
